case_map.note: sambandha is not a kāraka — taught as possession, never as a seventh relation

note: ESG order throughout: sentence-first, verb at the hub, relations before endings, pronouns early, domain vocabulary. kartṛ is not prathamā; sambandha is not a kāraka. Nominal declension paradigms (rāma etc., ESG IX-X) are a later wheel, not this intro.

stages.gate: tutor L1 drill: show iast, say en and reverse
stages.name: Six bases, no endings

stages.exit: place/time/source/manner endings placed; katham special + eka gaps noted
stages.gate: tutor L2 drill + wheel_verify on every form (AGREE or gap, never a pass on MACHINE_GAP)
stages.name: Endings join the bases

stages.exit: subject + present verb (+ one compatible object); asmi/asi/asti
stages.gate: compose ready() on the sentence levels: preliminaries first
stages.name: Who does what

stages.gate: compose drill on the level; weak items first via review()
stages.name: When and where

stages.exit: kutra/kadā/katham/kutas + mama/tava/tasya/tasyāḥ — ṣaṣṭhī arrives here as possession
stages.gate: compose drill; question modes stay gated until unlocked
stages.name: Asking + whose (ṣaṣṭhī arrives)

stages.exit: every noun parsed as verb + kāraka, then vibhakti — in that order; kartṛ ≠ prathamā stated
stages.gate: worked set: ahaṃ gacchāmi → grāmaṃ gacchāmi → manasā → pitre → grāmāt āgacchāmi → grāme asmi
stages.name: Six relationships (the ESG Topic III move)

stages.exit: full 5-ring scenes in 3 tenses; ≥85% on capstone with no hints
stages.name: Complete ashram scenes

stages_note: S0 runs first and gates S3/S7; S1-S2 may run alongside S0 (words are the material S0 drills).
title: The tight generative intro (ESG order over our wheels)

preliminaries.exit: 0.4 mixed readiness: 8 novel sentences, ≥7 accurate, no hints
preliminaries.gate: pack thresholds: 0.1 ≥16/20, 0.2 ≥8/10 roots + ≥24/30 forms, 0.3 recognition set, 0.4 readiness check (tutor-judged in chat; server scoring is a later wiring)
preliminaries.name: Preliminaries: 20 words + 10 roots
